context: Sho-young watches a robot show with Daichi; curious questions.
purpose: Father patiently explaining technology to child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、ロボット、動いてる!
lines.style: Sharp intake of breath on 'Dad.' Pitch lifts with genuine awe. Quick-paced excitement, but controlled — watching intently rather than shouting. Wonder outweighs volume.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Warm chuckle underlying the words. Slow, measured delivery. Leans in to share the moment with Sho. Pride in his son's engagement more than the tech itself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 未来、こんな世界になるの?
lines.en: Is the world going to be like this in the future?
lines.style: Tentative, genuinely wondering. Soft rise at the end — real question, not rhetorical. Pause before speaking, searching for the right thought.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Yeah — humans and machines, living together.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to himself. Warm but measured. One beat of silence after 'humans' — giving weight to the idea. Gentle certainty, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I want to make one too!
lines.style: Quiet determination breaking through. Soft but unwavering conviction. Looks up at his father — checking if this is allowed, if it's real. No doubt in the wanting, only in the asking.
